links.outcome: Factual accuracy of unedited AI feedback summaries: mischaracterization and hallucination rates
links.effect: Of 117 AI-generated feedback elements, 6.8% (n=8) were mischaracterized and 1.7% (n=2) were hallucinated.
links.quote: Review of 117 AI-generated feedback elements showed a 6.8% (n=8) mischaracterization and 1.7% (n=2) hallucination rate, with most errors corrected during editing.

links.outcome: Whether instructor editing of AI-drafted feedback notes corrected AI errors
links.effect: Most errors in AI summaries (6.8% mischaracterization, 1.7% hallucination) were corrected during instructor editing before submission.
links.quote: Review of 117 AI-generated feedback elements showed a 6.8% (n=8) mischaracterization and 1.7% (n=2) hallucination rate, with most errors corrected during editing.

unlisted_practices: Using ambient AI scribes to generate educational feedback narratives for medical students

screen.reason: The study tests an ambient AI scribe workflow in medical education against human-only feedback and evaluates instructor review/editing of AI-generated summaries to correct hallucinations and mischaracterizations.

primary.practice: instructor review and editing of AI-generated feedback
